balls.text: what did I tell you at the start of the over? Of course Arshdeep can! Yorker on off. He backs away to drive through cover. But the ball goes under the bat and breaks off stump. Smile for Arshdeep as he takes his five-wicket haul and Rajasthan Royals are all out for 185

that's four for Arshdeep as he gets under the catch himself. His best IPL figures too! Slower ball, back of a length. Sakariya looks to pull, but sliced up in the air. Arshdeep runs forward, settles under it, stretches forward and takes the catch
full just outside off stump. Backs away, makes room, and clatters a boundary through the covers! Made the width, earned the runs
full outside leg stump, and clipped away to fine leg for a single
low full toss outside off stump. Dragged down the ground to mid on
yorker length, outside leg stump. Misses the clip, hits the boot and rolls away to cover point
full on middle, and pushed back to Shami. Stops it on his own, and Shami finishes with 3/21

South African caught by South African This was in the slot, to be fair. Full just outside off, but Morris ends up slicing a lofted shot. Too high off the bat, has the height as it goes into the night sky, but the distance is missing. Second wicket for Shami in the over.
back of a length, around his waist outside leg stump. Nudged to fine leg for one
overpitched on off and driven to long off for a single. Tried the yorker again
full outside leg stump. Clipped to fine leg for one

beautiful! Gets the pace up, goes for the yorker, and successfully delivered at the base of leg. Tewatia looks to protect his toes, and in the process is late to bring the bat down. Stumps knocked back
back of a length, on off. Slower ball too. He drags a grounded pull to deep midwicket. Only seven off it, despite two wides.
full toss on middle stump, and he slogs it away to the gap between deep midwicket and long on
full on middle, and he drills a drive to the off side. Rashid fields at cover, and throws it in at the bowler. Saves the single with his effort
yorker, dipping into off stump. Jammed away to the bowler's right. Well dealt by Tewatia because that was honing into the base of off
full toss, very wide outside off. Slapped to mid off
perfect wide yorker? Nope! Again on the tramline and the umpire calls it a wide since Tewatia has not moved around in the crease

full on the fifth-stump line. Lomror looks to hit a six over long on, but the timing off the bat is not perfect. Markram at long on with a simple catch. But what a momentum-making innings this has been from Lomror! Was brutal on Hooda.
full and wide. Attempts the wide yorker. Offers no shot, and wide given. Tight call, 50-50 from the umpire
another yorker attempted. Nearly successful. Tewatia backs away and bunts it away to point for one
yorker attempted, nearly successful. Dug away to mid off for a quick single
full outside off from around the stumps. Sliced drive, rolls away to cover. Was in the slot to be put away to be honest

holes pout at long on! And Parag will be disappointed on missing out. Full just outside off stump, and he goes for the big one over Shami's head. Struck a bit more towards the on side, and that brings long on into play. Runs to his left, gobbles a catch
overpitched on middle, and he drills a shot down the ground to long on. Two for Parag
Shami returns. Over the stumps. Full ball just outside off. Bunted away to cover point
overpitched, wide outside off. Looks to play the square drive, but it's been flayed behind point instead. Beats the fielder, and the man in the deep has no chance either. 24 off the over
slapped to long off

wayward! Another full toss, very wide outside off. Lomror slaps a cut, but it falls safely near extra cover. Could've been a height no-ball since he met the ball at shoulder height, however Lomror had attacked the ball and the umpires believe it would have been a legal delivery if Lomror did not charge.
another full toss, another boundary. Full toss wider outside off. Lomror attacks the ball by slapping this inside out over cover, and it's got enough speed to hit the boundary skirting

demolished over deep midwicket! And this time it's the bottom hand that helps Lomror get the elevation through the on side. Good length ball on off stump. Cramping Lomror for space as he comes down the ground. But then he hits the whip/flick off his waist beautifully to send it over for more runs

first ball is a full and wide delivery, and Lomror doesn't need a second invitation. Comes down the ground, and hits a six over the bowler. Very Ganguly-esque in that approach. The second time Lomror has forced a change of balls
full toss as the ball slips out. On his pads, and flicked to deep midwicket. Harpreet's economy is just 5.67 after three overs when the team run-rate is 9.33
good length, wider outside off but angling in. Punched to long off for one
full on middle and leg. Skips down the ground and whips it to long on's left for a single
full outside off from around the stumps. Driven firmly to long off for a single

oh dear, Jaiswal is heartbroken! Out for 49, and maybe pays the price for becoming a bit tentative after getting close to 50. Full ball on middle. Looks to work it to midwicket, but the ball angles away, takes a leading edge, and Mayank at short cover dives forward to dismiss Jaiswal. This will disappoint Jaiswal immensely, but his anchoring innings has given Royals the base for a slog-overs assault from here on
cuts this length ball away to point
dragged! Short of a length on off. Turning away. Lomror doesn't have to do much. Just goes deep in his crease, and then pulls in front of square. Fielder a mere spectator over there!
my oh my! Hits Rashid with disdain. Tossed up, on middle. Lomror's eyes light up with the flight, and he absolutely creams a slog sweep over deep midwicket
full on middle. Presses forward and offers soft hands to a shot. Ball squirts away to point, they jog across for one
fullish outside off. Turning away further. Jaiswal rocks back to cut, but mistimed to point
full on off, turning away. Looks to go through cover but the turn takes it past the outside edge. Top googly

just short of Mayank at deep midwicket! So close to being a rocking catch. Full on off, and he plays the slog sweep. Hit well, hit low, but yet in the air. Falls just short of Mayank attacking the ball with a forward-dive catch
full on off stump. Flicked to deep midwicket's right for a single
fullish, on middle and leg. Works it to midwicket where there's no one. Brar has to run to his left to stop the second
good length ball outside off. Uses the width to slap a cut square. However there's a man in the deep on the off side
full on off, and nudged down the ground to wide long on for a single
fullish, outside leg stump. Pushed towards midwicket off the back foot for a single
good length, on leg stump from around the stumps. Punched down the ground to long on for one
good length, just outside off. Tapped off the back foot towards point after shuffling across to the off side

that's what Allen can do! And Arshdeep gives Livingstone a flying kiss. Short of good length, and Livingstone aims for that cow-corner six again. Struck well, but that's irrelevant when the flying Fabian Allen is in that region. Runs to his right from deep midwicket, then dives to his right, and the ball sticks in his hands despite a hard fall! Livingstone out after a cameo. Big wicket for the Kings to get in the 12th over

full and wide outside off. Angling across, and Livingstone looks to drive through cover. Ball goes under the bat, and over the tram-lines to the keeper. Arshdeep has now returned to his over-the-stumps line

sounds as beautiful as a Mozart composition! Length ball outside off stump. Not full pace. Livingstone stays in his crease and absolutely clatters a slog over deep midwicket for half a dozen. That sound off the bat....you know it came off the sweet spot
yorker length, just outside leg on his boot. But smartly flicked behind square, and it would've been four had Pooran not dived across the field

cute! Knew Arshdeep won't be bowling full pace. Livingstone softens his grip and runs across to the off side with Arshdeep on his delivery stride. Length ball on off, and that's been paddled down the leg side for a safe four!

back of a length slower ball. Leg stump line, and he can pump a pull square but it's been mistimed instead. Pooran at deep backward square fumbles on his pick up in the deep, and that allows the two to take a simple double
slower through the air. Full on middle, down on one knee and uses the bottom hand to lift a four over the bowler's head. Smart way to end the over
good length outside off and angling into middle. He comes down the ground to punch it straight back, but edged to the off side instead
full on leg stump from around the stumps. Livingstone goes deep, goes leg side, but the line follows him. Cramped for space, hit his pads.
good length ball around leg stump and angling into off. Punched off the back foot to long on
full ball, wider outside off. Skips down the ground for a slog, but mistimed to deep midwicket
full on off, from around the stumps, Mistimed drive right back to the bowler
good length ball on off, and he opens the bat face to dab that to point
cracked through the covers! Full delivery and in the slot outside off, as he remains deep in his crease to caress that to the left of the man at cover

goes for the scoop, but gets it off the inside edge to Rahul. Full ball outside off, and he goes across off to loft, but doesn't get the connection. They run a rapid single, as Rahul doesn't collect it cleanly to his left
good length ball on his pads, and he clips that to fine leg with a little shuffle across off
swings this fullish ball on off to deep square leg. Looked like he wanted to send that into space, but couldn't time it
shortish in length on off, and he pulls that to long-on. This is now his highest IPL score as well
very full on middle again, and clipped to deep midwicket
good length ball on off, and turning away a touch. Punched off the back foot to long-off
pretty full on middle, and clipped to the man at deep square leg
whacked over deep square leg! Short delivery on middle, and he stays deep in his crease to swivel with that pull for the maximum. Absolutely carved that one into the stands
fullish length on off, and cut away to deep point from deep in his crease
very full on off, and jammed back to the bowler

dropped by Rahul? Nope, that came off his pad. Very full ball on leg, as Livingstone goes for the flick but the ball takes his pad. Rahul stretches out his left glove, as the ball drops out of his hands to allow a leg-bye
fuller delivery on middle, and angling in. Goes down leg, and is called wide, as Rahul goes low to his left to take that

flashed aerially, but safe in the end! Goes for the push to this good length ball outside off, as the ball flies off the outside half of the bat to the deep point fence, and to the left of the fielder there

good length ball again, but on middle and leg. Goes for the pull, but seems to have been hit near on the box, as the ball trickles to the leg side. Jaiswal is down now, and expectedly so, as the physio rushes in
good length ball on off, and punched from close to his body to the man at point
shuffles across off to this full ball outside off, and flicks it to fine leg to get off the mark

nabbed by Rahul one-handed! Samson goes for the slash to this good length ball slightly wide of off, and gets a top edge. The ball flies off his bat, as Rahul hangs out his right glove while leaping after the ball comes to him a touch higher too. Very good catch to send back his counterpart
good length ball just outside off, and cut to cover. Good stop by Arshdeep diving to his left to save a couple
wrong one, and this keeps low. Short in length on middle, and goes away from him as he misses his pull
Crashed over long-off! That was tossed up on a full length outside off, and he simply lifts that for the maximum. Not much force there, just timing
short in length on off, and pushed back to the bowler from deep in his crease
reverse-swept over short third man!. Full ball outside off, and he got into position early there
googly first up. Fullish in length on middle and off, and swung away after he comes down the track. But that comes off the inside half of the bat to square leg
slower ball, and a leading edge to mid-off. Samson flicks this full ball on off, and sets off for a single immediately
good length ball just outside off, and dabs that toward cover from close to his body
short of a length on middle, and pulled to deep square leg in front of square. The man there runs to his left to keep that to two

sliced to extra cover! Another change of pace ball by Arshdeep. He bowls this pretty full on off, as Lewis looks to go inside out over cover, but mistimes this time. Agarwal goes low right on the edge of the circle to complete the catch. Much-needed breakthrough for Kings
lofts this full ball on off to deep point, with the fielder there running across to his left. Jaiswal slips at the bowler's end, and that keeps them to a single
starts with a slower ball. Shortish is length, and a little wide of off. Jaiswal goes to cut early, but is beaten by the lack of pace
finds the gap between square leg and short fine leg! Again sweeps this full ball on middle, and that raises his side's fifty too
full-toss, and hammered over mid-off! This was tossed up, but was too full on middle and leg, as Lewis rides on to the opportunity
short of a length on off, and cut from close to his body to the man at cover-point
goes down on his back knee to sweep this full ball on middle, and that strikes his front pad instead
clips this full ball on middle and leg to square leg
shortish in length, and he finds the gap between extra cover and cover-point with his cut. Not the ideal start for the spinner
bisects extra cover and mid-off! Glorious timing there. Reads the slower early, as he waits for it to come on a full length just outside off, and cracks a drive for another four. 17 off the over
creams that pull to beat the man at deep square leg! Short delivery again, and this was just outside off. Cracks this pull to the right of the man at the boundary
change of pace again, and ballooned to mid-off, but safe. Almost cramped for room there, as he pushes at that, with the ball going on the bounce to the fielder
another swing, and another four! This time between the keeper and short third man. Goes for the heave to the leg side, but gets it off the outside edge, with this one being a slower ball
goes flashing at that, and gets it off the outside edge over short third man! Short and wide outside off, and with third man inside the circle, it flies over his head for another four
another pull to a short ball on middle, and he swivels in his crease again
fuller in length on middle and off, and darting away from the left-hander, who lets this one go, as Rahul has to go low to his left to collect that
rammed over the bowler's head! Right in the slot on a full length just outside off, but this time Lewis remains deep in his crease to loft that on the bounce and into the fence
and again past the outside edge! More Test match line and length now. Fullish and in the channel outside off, as Lewis goes for the drive but is beaten
goes for the heave again, but is beaten! That was again close to in the slot on off, but he missed his swing, with the ball beating his outside edge
opens the bat face to this good length ball on off, and pushes that to the man at point
short and just outside off, cut to the man at third man off the outside edge
sliced over mid-on for six! Full length ball and in the slot on off, as Lewis stays leg side of the ball to climb on that. Free swing of the bat, and whacked!
good length delivery just outside off, clipped to the man also inside the circle square leg after a little shuffle across off
another full ball on leg, as he misses his flick and the ball rolls over to short fine leg off his front pad
full and just outside off. He goes for the heave, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to the right of short fine leg for a single
fuller ball on his pads, and clipped to Rashid at short fine leg. He throws back at the striker's end, as Lewis pats his bat back inside the crease
goes for the pull to this shortish ball outside leg, but misses. There is half an appeal for caught behind, but it is called wide
good length ball on middle and leg, clipped off his hips to square leg

slower ball pulled for four! Short in length again, but this was on middle. He rocks back in his crease, and swivels with a pull to deep square leg for back-to-back fours. Good start for Royals and Jaiswal

this time connects, and the ball flies to the third man fence! Short of a length and just wide of off, and he slashes this from close to his body. The ball takes a top edge, but goes on the bounce to the fielder's left
much fuller on off, and a slower ball too. Taps this toward point after waiting for the ball to come
similar to the previous ball, but this one has more bounce. Slightly back of a length and a touch wide of off, as Jaiswal is beaten on his cut
fullish and wide of off. Angles away after pitching too, as Jaiswal has a flash at that away from his body, but the ball passes his bat
good length ball on middle, and that is pulled to the man at deep square with a swivel. His front leg was in the air as he played that

Kartik Tyagi, you hero! From being a teenager who won games of cricket at the U-19 World Cup in 2020, he has done a near impossible on the IPL field today. Full, wide, and Allen can't connect with the drive. Through to Samson and Royals win by two runs after bowling five dot balls in the final over A whirlwind experience, repaying the faith his captain has shown tonight.
make that three in 1! Tyagi takes another wicket. Full and wide outside off stump. Looks to drive away from his body, and it takes an edge to Samson. The new batter will face the last ball.
full and wide outside off stump. Beyond the tramline too. But the umpire says its a legal ball since Hooda had walked across to the off side

guided....to the keeper! Overpitched just outside off. Pooran opens the bat's face to run it down to third man. But all he has done is poked it straight to Samson. Kings need 3 off 3. And it's a new batter facing the next delivery.
full on off. Goes for the extravagant slog through midwicket, but inside edge takes it to deep backward square leg
full toss just outside off. Driven towards the off side but can't beat the fielder at cover
full ball outside leg stump. Played inside out to deep extra cover for one.
low yorker outside off stump. Drilled to long on for one

just past Samson! Back of a length outside leg stump. Slower ball too. Markram backs away to cut but takes an edge going across. Samson jumps to his right to take a catch, but all he can do is glove the dropped chance. However, Sakariya at short third man moves to his left to stop the four, saving his side three runs for sure
slashed to third man who is very very fine. Wide yorker attempted, and he gets enough in the bat to get an edge. Mustafizur bowling wide of the crease again. But it's a fair ball, not a no-ball
wide yorker. Delivers it from wide of the crease. Pooran bends his knee to drive low through cover point. But no connection
back of a length, wider outside off. Pooran throws his bat at it to cut behind square. Misses out
waist-high full toss. Tapped off the back foot to cover point for a single. Surprised Pooran there
low full toss on middle. Driven to mid on, where Tewatia's quick work sends Markram back. Direct hit at the bowler's end though, and that allows Pooran-Markram take the single anyway

attempted slower ball gone wrong. Ends up as a full toss that Markram ducked under. Goes over Markram's back but legal ball called. Because the ball was dipping so sharply. Morris has his hands on his head since he thought Markram could've been bowled!
good length, on middle and off. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket. Fifty stand in 28 balls
full on off stump. The cover drive is mistimed to mid on
third tier! Full on off. Markram swings the bat to whack it over cow corner after picking the slower ball up early. That shot tells you that Markram loves playing golf on his off days. Into the crowd
full on middle and off. Driven to long off for one. Kings need 18 in 18
good length ball on middle that generates some extra bounce. Mistimed defensive shot rolls away to cover
full just outside off stump. Shovels a lofted shot over the cover region. Lands safe, and that allows Pooran to take three
second tier! Length ball, 113kph. Pooran was probably expecting the slower ball, and he's picked it off his waist to pull it for six over cow corner
short and wide. Walks across to cut it. Misses out. Through to Samson
good length wide outside off. Looks to cut although it's fairly close to the body. Thick edge, past the keeper along the ground. Tyagi can't cut it off at third man.
fullish on middle. Tapped towards point with soft hands and they are off for a quick run again
full, wider outside off. Mistimed drive to mid off for a quick single
full on leg stump, but going further down leg. Tries to flick it off his toes like how Mayank hit those two sixes off Morris. Misses out
good length, outside off. Not full enough to drive. Mistimed shot to cover's right. Jaiswal dives, and intercepts
full just outside off. Tapped away to point with soft hands. Enough time to pinch a single
uppish drive but just over cover! Good length outside off, and drives away from his body
back of a length on middle and off. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket

straight as an arrow! Full, in the slot on off stump, Markram powers onto the front foot and absolutely hammers a straight drive past the bowler. Tyagi can't finish the over well...concedes a four after just two runs in five balls
full on off stump. Pushed to cover's left for a quick single
yorker length slower ball. Dipping delivery lands just outside off. Pooran looks to go for the glory shot over mid off. No connection, beaten by the lack of pace
good length ball angling across. Pooran looks to drive away from his body but no connection
back of a length just outside leg stump. Ducks under it, but legal ball says umpire Anil
full just outside off and worked off his pads to deep midwicket for one
smacked! Parag with a half-tracker that doesn't even turn. Lands on middle. Pooran backs away to free his arms up, and then he thumps a flat-batted shot over long on
fullish, outside off. Drills a drive off the front foot to long off
length ball on middle, and turning further in. It's going down leg for a wide but Markram goes for a pull behind square. However it takes the glove, and dribbles past short fine leg for four. Lucky!
conventional release. Full on middle, and swept to fine leg for a single
good length, on middle. Angling into him from around the stumps. Whips a shot off his hips to deep backward fine leg
nearly takes Markram's head en route to long on. Length ball outside off, and he clatters a flat-batted shot down the ground

tossed up, full outside off. Goes for the inside out drive over cover, but sliced it instead. In the air, flies to deep point, and Livingstone isn't dropping those! There's the second opener gone, Agarwal out for 67
full on middle, and he drives gently down to long on for one

full on middle. Turning into leg. Inside out drive to cover. Stopped beautifully by Jaiswal diving to his left. Direct hit at the keeper's end and they pinch an overthrow instead. But the TV umpire is going to have a look at the run-out nonetheless. Agarwal had run out for the single before scurrying back following Jaiswal's effort. He's safe
full just outside off. Driven down the ground. Tewatia gets a fingertip to it, slowing the ball's pace down
shouts of catch it but lands well short of long on. Full ball outside off that he slog swept down the ground
full ball on off and skidding into his pads. Flicked off his pads to deep square leg where Lewis is slow off the blocks. Gets the second run
full ball on middle stump. Fended with soft hands off the front foot
another one out on 49! Jaiswal a few hours ago, Rahul now. Good length ball angling across. Tries to cut through point but the slower ball gets a thicker edge. Straight to Tyagi at short third man
slower ball, fullish just outside off stump. Nudged away to deep point for one
good length, outside off stump. Gently bunted to cover point for a single
good length, outside off stump. Looks to cut, but bottom-edged towards the keeper
full and wide outside off stump. Angling across, inside the tram-lines, but the umpire has given it a wide
slapped! Full and wide outside off but Rahul walks across to that side exposing all stumps. Successfully anticipated the wide yorker, and he has driven this through the off side for four first ball!
checks his shot late, but does enough to beat point! Length ball on off that he wanted to drive over cover but ends up nudging it behind square instead
whippy lift over the bowler's head. Breaks his wrists to play a controlled shot down the ground for one. Full on middle and leg
full on leg stump. Drills a straight drive through the non-striker's legs to long on
length ball outside off again. Tapped to the off side
flatter, length ball on off. Cut in front of square to the man in the deep
around the stumps. Short ball just outside off. Drags a pull to deep midwicket
goes inside out over cover, and that is 25 off the over! Good length outside off, and lofted over for four more
slower ball, and full on leg again. Clipped to deep square leg

very full on middle and leg, and clipped to the left of short fine leg. The hundred stand is up too, the fourth time they have done that. Simply clips this delivery close to his pads, and gets the result
wide again. Full and outside leg, and Rahul doesn't need to touch that
full and very wide of off. Keeps angling away from the batter, and is called wide. They even run one there
and a repeat of the first ball! That's his fifty too. The ball is full outside leg, and again Mayank clips that over fine leg, though this over is a tier lower. Massive six
goes jabbing, but is beaten. Good length ball just outside off at 136kph, and he gets good bounce too. The ball goes over Mayank's bat on this occasion
shortish in length, and pitches outside leg again. Keeps angling down, and it is a wide. Samson not happy with that
sends that into the second tier over fine leg! That was a length ball outside leg, and he whacks that with his bat swinging from off stump. Phew, what a blow to welcome Morris back!
on the bounce to long-on! Mayank repeats that wristy loft to this full ball on middle, but finds the fielder
skips down to this full ball on off, and lofts that off the inside half of the bat to long-on
shorter in length in middle, and pulled to deep midwicket with not great timing
whipped over the bowler's head! That is very straight, as it is right in the slot on middle, and he again has his front leg outside leg to allow him the room
good length ball on middle, and much quicker - at 90kph. Pushed down the ground to long-on
tossed up, but full and wide of off. Goes to heave that, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
leading edge, but safe. Goes to flick this full ball on off, but gets it off the edge down to long-off for a single
shortish and wide of off. Cut to deep point from deep in his crease
fuller ball on middle, and flicked to deep square leg

Parag gives it his all at long-on, but that is still three fours in a row! The fielder runs to his left and dives too, but the ball trickles off after getting contact. Mayank simply chipped that full on middle, and again there was more timing that power
gloriously lofted! Goes inside out over cover to this fullish ball outside off. His front leg is again on leg, and that gives him the room to loft that brilliantly

outside edge, but four! Mayank goes flashing at this full ball outside off, which is also in the slot. But there is no foot movement there, as he plays away from his body. Edge flies to the right of the helpless Samson
full on middle and off, and clipped to deep square leg
appeal for leg before again, but not given. Mayank goes for the sweep to this full ball on middle which is turning into him. Seemed to be missing leg again
one bounce, and into the ropes! Just seemed to be chipping this full ball on middle over the bowler's head, as he clears his front leg
Rahul makes room, and the bowler follows. Shortish outside leg, and punched down to long-on
much fuller on middle and leg, and Rahul misses his sweep. Appeal for leg before by Samson, but that seemed to have been missing leg
fullish on middle, and clipped to square leg to raise the fifty opening stand
good length ball outside leg, and wide, as it was turning into the batter
driven to mid-off, as Fizz goes full on off stump. A stable start by Kings in a hefty chase

dropped by Sakariya this time! Rahul survives for the third time. Sakariya goes low to his right, and the ball drops out after touching his fingers. Anyway, it was another slower ball on a fullish length on leg, which Rahul pulled behind
slashed to deep point. Full delivery and wide of off, and Mayank stretches out to play that
cracked right down the wicket! Another slower ball on a full length on middle, and Mayank uses his wrists to lift that over the bowler's head
change of pace again, and goes very full outside off - almost a yorker. Mayank has a flash at that with his bottom hand off, but is beaten by the lack of pace
very full outside off, and a slower ball too. Jammed to point for a single

dropped by Parag at mid-on! More luck for Rahul. He clips this full ball on middle, and got that off the bottom of the bat. Parag ran back and across to his right, as the ball popped out of his hands while he tried to grab that. Another life for Rahul. Will these drops make all the difference in the end?
Mayank takes off for a run, but is sent back. Slower ball from Morris on a fuller length on middle and leg, as Rahul pulls, but the ball takes his pad to short fine leg
more of a short-arm pull, and even in the air, but safe. Short ball on middle, and his pull lands between square leg and mid-on
short and wide of off. Mayank goes for the upper cut, but doesn't connect. There was good bounce there too
opens the bat face to this good length ball just outside off to dab that to point
just clears mid-on. Parag turns back and runs behind, but the ball beats him. Shorter in length on off, and Rahul pulled, but off the upper half of the bat
starts with a wide. Good length ball pitches on leg, and continues to angle away. Too far for Rahul to get a bat with his pull
full delivery outside off, and Rahul gets an inside edge to this drive. Good stop by Mustafizur diving to his left at short fine leg
back of a length, and wide of off. Cut to deep point, although not quite from the middle of the bat
good length ball on middle, and clipped toward midwicket
pulled over fine leg for six more! That is also 3000 IPL runs for Rahul. Short delivery on middle, and he swivels to swing that away. That came off the upper part of the bat, but is still six
tonked over the bowler's head! That was in the slot on a full length on off, and he got into it with a straight bat for six. Nice follow through too, as he lofts that for the maximum
bisects short third man and point! Good length ball just outside off, and he opens the bat face to dab that really late. Good shot, and a good result
very full on middle and off, and Rahul gets an inside edge to his flick. The ball rolls over to the off side to allow a single
beaten this time! Goes driving to this ball in the slot and a touch wide of off, but can't get bat on ball, as the ball passes his outside edge while he plays without any foot movement
full-toss on off, and that is swung to deep point! Finds the gap between point and shirt third man, as he slashes at that from deep in his crease with his front leg out of the way
goes for the flick-cum-heave to this full ball on middle and leg, but gets an inside edge on to his pads, as the ball trickles to the on side. It is a no-ball though

Samson appeals for caught behind, but it is not given. And he reviews. Short delivery not very wide of off, and with good bounce too. Mayank tries to ramp that really late, as the ball passes his outside edge. UltraEdge confirms there is no edge, and Royals lose their review
again goes really full on middle, as Mayank punches it down to mid-on too, with his front leg slightly out of the way
pretty full on middle, and driven down to mid-on. Karthik starts with a 140kph ball
good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep square leg for another single
punches this fullish ball on middle and off to deep point to beat the cover fielder to his left. Brilliant calling and running there

dropped by Lewis at point! Just two balls he made a good stop, but this time puts it down. Dives to his right - his wrong side - as Rahul cuts this short and wide ball outside off while playing aerially
now it is Parag at mid-on with a good stop. Dives to his right to collect that on the bounce. Short ball on middle and Mayank pulls from deep in his crease
excellent stop by Lewis at point! Dives to his left to stop that. Mayank opens the bat face to this fuller ball outside off and pushes it to point, but can't find the gap
good length ball and a touch wide of off. Good bounce too, as Mayank misses his cut, with the ball riding over his bat
another slower ball. Full delivery on middle, and flicked to the right of mid-on
change of pace again. This is on a good length on leg, as he clips this behind the wicket to short fine leg for a single
full delivery outside off, and drives it right to the man at extra cover. A slower ball too on this occasion
full ball and in the driving length outside off. Pushed to the left of mid-off for a quick single
good length ball and a touch wide of off. Rides the bounce to cut that to deep point, who is one of the two men on the boundary
full delivery outside off, and he opens the bat face to tap that right to the fielder at short third man
